coverage_note: A 12-person committee from 10 men and 10 women: parts (a), (b) and the five cases of (c) were readable. Parts (d) and (e) were past the cut and are not described anywhere in this repository.
concepts: Exactly 6 men and 6 women: C(10,6) x C(10,6) = 44100 - independent choices multiply.
Even number of women: sum over disjoint cases k = 2,4,6,8,10 giving 63090; k = 0 is infeasible because 12 men do not exist.
Check disjointness and feasibility before adding cases.
